title: Check the current context
summary: A context chooses a cluster, user and sometimes namespace. Read it first so you know where a command would act.
introduction: A context chooses a cluster, user and sometimes namespace. Read it first so you know where a command would act. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: The output shows configured contexts. A learning setup should use an explicitly chosen local context.
